quotes.speaker: Oso Ighodaro
quotes.summary_phrase: Ighodaro compares the mental demands of NBA and college basketball
quotes.excerpt: college it's less thinking than the NBA game I feel like in the NBA guys are so talented
quotes.quote: College it's less thinking than the NBA game. I feel like in the NBA guys are so talented and there's so much space on the floor that you can't sit still for a second. In college, you can stand in the paint, you can there's opportunities to catch your breath. But at the same time, in college, we're practicing live for two and a half hours the two days before the game. So at Marquette, every single drill is live. So I'm so grateful for that experience there and how hard we push each other.
quotes.social_post: Oso Ighodaro on the transition from college to the NBA: in the NBA guys are so talented and there is so much space on the floor that you cannot sit still for a second.
